Amenify Frequently Asked Questions

1. What services does Amenify provide?
Amenify offers home cleaning services, handyman services, chores services, food delivery, grocery delivery services and more. Whether you need assistance cleaning your home, hanging shelves, running errands, or having groceries delivered to your doorstep, we streamline all your household needs.

2. How do I find out if Amenify offers services near me?
Amenify is live in all the cities in the US. The Amenify Resident App allows you to easily schedule any of our services, including house cleaning service, apartment cleaning services, and chores services near me.

3. Are your residential cleaners near me and other Service Pros trained and background-checked?
Absolutely. We carefully vet all residential cleaners and regularly monitor performance of all our Pros including Handyman. Our training process emphasizes not only cleaning expertise but also reliability and professionalism, giving you peace of mind with every visit.

4. Can Amenify handle urgent household tasks like handyman services?
Yes. Alongside our scheduled cleaning, we offer handyman services for minor repairs and maintenance. This includes fixing leaks, mounting TVs, and other small projects that can be difficult to tackle on your own.

5. Do you offer food delivery and grocery delivery services?
We do! Amenify partners with trusted providers to fulfill food delivery and grocery delivery requests. You can schedule deliveries through our easy-to-use platform, eliminating the hassle of traffic, long lines, or last-minute store runs.

6. Is there a difference between your house cleaning and apartment cleaning services?
Yes. House cleaning service is tailored to larger spaces and includes tasks like cleaning multiple bathrooms, spacious kitchens, and extended living areas. Our apartment cleaning services focus on efficiently cleaning smaller spaces without compromising quality. Either way, our teams follow a thorough checklist customized to your needs.

7. Does Amenify offer move out cleaning services for rentals?
Absolutely. Our move out cleaning services are perfect for renters looking to secure their deposits or homeowners preparing to sell. Amenify's cleaning teams address everything from deep-cleaning appliances to dusting baseboards, ensuring a spotless environment.

8. Why should I choose Amenify over other home cleaning companies?
Amenify has exclusive tie ups with your community and offers Signup and monthly credits. Amenify stands out by integrating multiple lifestyle services — like chores services, food delivery, and handyman services — into one user-friendly platform. We deliver exceptional residential cleaning services combined with advanced technology, flexible scheduling, and top-notch customer support, making us the go-to solution for all your household needs. Amenify gives you the freedom to plan cleaning tasks that vary depending on your needs, availability, budget and more.

Amenify Cleaning Services

Amenify provides professional cleaning services for apartments and homes.

Types of Cleaning Services:

1. Standard Cleaning (Hotel-Style Surface Clean):
- Surface-level cleaning similar to hotel housekeeping
- Includes wiping surfaces, vacuuming, mopping, bathroom cleaning
- Perfect for regular maintenance cleaning

2. Deep Cleaning:
- Thorough, intensive cleaning of the entire space
- Includes behind appliances, inside cabinets, detailed scrubbing
- Recommended for first-time cleanings or periodic thorough cleaning

3. Move-Out Cleaning:
- Comprehensive cleaning for tenants moving out
- Designed to help renters secure their security deposits
- Covers deep-cleaning appliances, dusting baseboards, ensuring spotless environment
- Also suitable for homeowners preparing to sell

House Cleaning vs Apartment Cleaning:
- House cleaning is tailored to larger spaces with multiple bathrooms, spacious kitchens, and extended living areas
- Apartment cleaning focuses on efficiently cleaning smaller spaces without compromising quality
- Both follow a thorough checklist customized to individual needs

How to Book:
- Download the Amenify Resident App
- Select your cleaning service type
- Choose your preferred date and time
- Our vetted, background-checked professionals will arrive at the scheduled time

Pricing:
- Competitive pricing with monthly credit benefits
- Signup credits available for new users (up to $50)
- Up to 30% savings with Amenify

All cleaning professionals are:
- Background-checked
- Professionally trained
- Rated and monitored through the app
- Assigned specific time windows based on data-driven resident feedback
